headline: Strategic Exchanges Continue on Divided Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns put Fisherman’s Row and Tempest Island back in the immediate dispatches: each recorded four strategic-base events in the freshest two-hour window, with Fisherman’s Row still divided six Warden to three Colonial and Tempest Island two to seven. Godcrofts also logged a fresh exchange, though its ledger remains nine Warden-held bases and its daily event count has eased to 12. Farranac Coast continues as a contested sector, with three events in six hours and 15 across the day; its four-to-seven split is unchanged. Lykos Isle remains unsettled at three Warden bases to four Colonial, but its 24-hour event total stands at 24 with no new event in the last two hours, while both casualty streams and enlistments are accelerating sharply. Deadlands retains its four-to-seven division and five daily events around The Salt March. Beyond those ledgers, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse carry the heaviest fighting: both show sharply elevated casualty rates and enlistment activity, though neither recorded a strategic-base event in the latest day. Several rear sectors remain quiet.
